notes: Batch of 20 Penn clubs, all listed INACTIVE in the directory, though nearly all carry an active flag of true. Six full records were written (Effective Altruism, GRC, Grey Matters, Heart Health, FIMRC, Government and Politics Association), each backed by a 2026 item from the club's own site or form, or in one case a 2026 deadline in the directory. The other 14 are held back with status unknown and no summary, because no dated activity inside the last 12 months was found or the site had no usable content. Instagram, Facebook and GroupMe were not used as sources. Personal-looking student addresses on the directory were left out. Owner judgment call: the Government and Politics Association is a student political group that calls itself all-partisan; it is published as nonpartisan and open_to is set to students pending owner confirmation. WebSearch used: 0. WebFetch used: 44 of 60.
